notes.title: One Jump Bomb Updates and Bugs Fixed
notes.notes:
We have just updated One Jump Bomb!
We have:
-Fixed the level 10 bug
-Fixed the disappering of the background in some levels
-Fixed the gamepad control input
-Fixed other minor bugs

notes.title: One Jump Bomb Demo
notes.notes:

We wanted to start with a simple game, just for fun and to get used to the steamworks platform. Right now we are working on another  more serious project .
 If you want, you can try our game for free here (so you won't need to ask for a refund ːsteamfacepalmː)
